plans.objective: Verify that the migrated shiftPitchLinear output equals the exact floor-modulo element permutation for the source's nominal valid configuration (W=2048, H=2048, shiftX=5, shiftY=7).
plans.observation: The values out[y*P_out+x] for every logical output coordinate 0<=x<W and 0<=y<H. Padding columns x>=W are not read or compared.
plans.pass_condition: For every (x,y) with 0<=x<W and 0<=y<H, the 32 bits of out[y*P_out+x] equal the 32 bits of gold[y*W+x] (exact binary32 equality via memcmp); zero mismatches and no floating-point tolerance is applied.
plans.setup: Use W=2048, H=2048, shiftX=5, shiftY=7. (1) Allocate host input h_idata of W*H floats and fill h_idata[i]=(float)i for i in [0,W*H). (2) Allocate a device source input d_in with a recorded element pitch P_in>=W (source pattern: cudaMallocPitch with row width W*sizeof(float) and height H, or migrated-equivalent) and copy h_idata into d_in with a 2D copy using host pitch W*sizeof(float) and device pitch P_in*sizeof(float). (3) Bind/provide d_in as the migrated kernel's source input: create an input handle over d_in using width W, height H, the actual device pitch of d_in, normalized coordinates, point filtering, and wrap addressing on both axes (source pattern: cudaCreateTextureObject over cudaResourceTypePitch2D, or migrated-equivalent); record the handle. (4) Allocate the migrated device output buffer d_out with a recorded element pitch P_out>=W (source pattern: cudaMallocPitch with row width W*sizeof(float) and height H, or migrated-equivalent); set P_out=allocated_pitch_bytes/sizeof(float). Allocate host out with H*P_out floats. (5) Compute gold[j*W+i]=h_idata[floor_mod(j+shiftY,H)*W + floor_mod(i+shiftX,W)] using integer floor_mod(n,m)=((n%m)+m)%m. (6) Launch the migrated kernel with (d_out,P_out,W,H,shiftX,shiftY,input_handle) using grid=(W/16,H/16)=(128,128) and block=(16,16) (the source dimGrid/dimBlock for W=2048,H=2048, or a migrated-equivalent launch that writes every logical coordinate exactly once). (7) Copy the full pitched output buffer (H rows of P_out elements each) back to host out.

plans.objective: Independently verify that the migrated shiftPitchLinear implements exact floor-modulo translation by (sx,sy), using direct host-computed floor-modulo gold arrays for s1=(5,7), s2=(1,1), and s3=(6,8), and using permutation, identity, periodicity, and composition relations as additional consistency checks.
plans.observation: For each single-shift run and the composed run, the W*H logical output values for 0<=x<W and 0<=y<H, plus the direct gold1, gold2, and gold3 comparisons; padding columns x>=W are excluded from all comparisons.
plans.pass_condition: All of the following hold exactly: (a) for s1, s2, and s3 individually, every out[y*P+x] equals gold_k[y*W+x] (exact binary32 equality via memcmp); (b) for each single-shift run, the sorted logical output multiset equals the sorted logical input multiset, so each distinct value appears exactly once (a permutation); (c) the (0,0) run equals the input elementwise; (d) the composed s2-after-s1 output equals gold3 elementwise and also equals the s3 run elementwise; (e) the (5+W,7) run and the (5,7+H) run both equal gold1 elementwise.
plans.setup: Use W=2048, H=2048 and host input h_idata[i]=(float)i for i in [0,W*H), which are distinct exact binary32 values because W*H=4194304<2^24. (1) Provision the input for initial runs: allocate device input d_in with recorded element pitch P_in>=W, copy h_idata into d_in with a 2D copy (host pitch W*sizeof(float), device pitch P_in*sizeof(float)), and bind/provide d_in as the input handle (texture object over d_in using its actual device pitch, width W, height H, normalized coordinates, point filtering, wrap addressing; or migrated-equivalent). (2) Allocate device output d_out with recorded element pitch P_out>=W and set P=P_out; allocate host output buffers of H*P floats. (3) Compute direct floor-modulo gold arrays gold1, gold2, and gold3 for s1=(5,7), s2=(1,1), and s3=(6,8), where gold_k[j*W+i]=h_idata[floor_mod(j+sy_k,H)*W + floor_mod(i+sx_k,W)] and floor_mod(n,m)=((n%m)+m)%m. (4) Launch the migrated kernel for shift (0,0) into d_out using grid=(W/16,H/16)=(128,128) and block=(16,16) (or migrated-equivalent covering every logical coordinate exactly once) and read back; then launch s1 into d_out using the same launch configuration and read back, retaining d_out (which now holds the s1 output) with its recorded pitch P_out. (5) For the composed run, allocate a second device output d_out2 with recorded element pitch P2>=W; bind/provide the retained d_out as the input for the second run (input handle over d_out using width W, height H, and d_out's actual device pitch P_out*sizeof(float), or migrated-equivalent), and launch the migrated kernel with (d_out2,P2,W,H,1,1,composed_input_handle) using the same launch configuration; copy d_out2 back and record its logical values. (6) Release the composed_input_handle, then continue with the remaining single-shift runs s2=(1,1), s3=(6,8), (5+W,7), and (5,7+H) into d_out using the original d_in input handle, reading back after each with the same launch configuration.

plans.objective: Verify exact floor-modulo wrap behavior at the logical edges and under negative shifts where the integer sums remain representable.
plans.observation: For each shift vector (sx,sy), the W*H values h_out[y*P+x] for 0<=x<W and 0<=y<H.
plans.pass_condition: For every shift vector (sx,sy) and every logical (x,y), h_out[y*P+x] equals in[floor_mod(y+sy,H)*W + floor_mod(x+sx,W)] with integer floor_mod(n,m)=((n%m)+m)%m. In particular, shifts (W,0) and (0,H) must reproduce the input identically, and negative shifts must wrap from the far edge; any implementation using truncated C '%' instead of floor-modulo fails.
plans.setup: Choose small W=4, H=3 so every logical coordinate is on or adjacent to an edge. (1) Allocate host input in of W*H floats and fill in[y*W+x]=y*W+x (each value exactly representable in binary32). (2) Provision the migrated kernel's source input: allocate device input d_in with recorded element pitch P_in>=W, copy in into d_in with a 2D copy (host pitch W*sizeof(float), device pitch P_in*sizeof(float)), and bind/provide d_in as the input handle (texture object over d_in using its actual device pitch, width W, height H, normalized coordinates, point filtering, wrap addressing; or migrated-equivalent). (3) Allocate the migrated device output d_out with recorded element pitch P_out>=W (source pattern: cudaMallocPitch with row width W*sizeof(float) and height H, or migrated-equivalent) and set P=P_out; allocate host output h_out of H*P floats. (4) For each shift vector in {(0,0),(1,0),(W-1,0),(W,0),(0,1),(0,H-1),(0,H),(-1,0),(0,-1),(-1,-1),(W-1,H-1)}, launch the migrated kernel with (d_out,P,W,H,sx,sy,input_handle) using an explicit launch configuration that writes all and only the W*H logical coordinates: grid=(1,1) and block=(W,H)=(4,3) (or a migrated-equivalent launch with one thread per logical output coordinate and no out-of-bounds threads). Copy the full pitched output (H rows of P elements) back to h_out, and record the logical values.

plans.objective: Confirm that the oracle evaluates only logical output columns 0<=x<W and that arbitrary padding-column contents cannot affect the pass/fail decision, consistent with the dimension scope.
plans.observation: The confirmed pitch P, and the count of logical-column mismatches for copy A and copy B when only logical columns 0<=x<W are compared against gold, plus the resulting pass/fail decision for each copy.
plans.pass_condition: P>W is confirmed (at least one padding column exists). Both copy A and copy B have zero logical-column mismatches and the same pass decision. Any difference in padding columns x>=W must not change the decision, enforcing that padding columns are outside the specified output behavior.
plans.setup: For W=2048, H=2048, shiftX=5, shiftY=7. (1) Allocate host h_idata of W*H floats and fill h_idata[i]=(float)i for i in [0,W*H). (2) Allocate device input d_in with recorded element pitch P_in>=W (source pattern: cudaMallocPitch with row width W*sizeof(float) and height H, or migrated-equivalent), copy h_idata into d_in with a 2D copy (host pitch W*sizeof(float), device pitch P_in*sizeof(float)), and bind/provide d_in as the migrated kernel's input handle (texture object over d_in using its actual device pitch, width W, height H, normalized coordinates, point filtering, wrap addressing; or migrated-equivalent). (3) Allocate the migrated output buffer with element pitch P strictly greater than W: request row width (W+1)*sizeof(float) and height H (source pattern: cudaMallocPitch((void**)&d_out,&d_pitchBytes,(W+1)*sizeof(float),H) or migrated-equivalent), set P=d_pitchBytes/sizeof(float), and verify P>W before proceeding. (4) Launch the migrated kernel with (d_out,P,W,H,shiftX,shiftY,input_handle) using grid=(W/16,H/16)=(128,128) and block=(16,16) (or a migrated-equivalent launch that writes every logical coordinate exactly once). (5) Copy the full pitched output (H rows of P elements each) back to host out. (6) Make two host copies of out: in copy A overwrite every padding column x>=W with the NaN bit pattern 0x7FC00000, and in copy B overwrite every padding column x>=W with 0x00000000. (7) Compute gold[j*W+i]=h_idata[floor_mod(j+shiftY,H)*W + floor_mod(i+shiftX,W)] using integer floor_mod(n,m)=((n%m)+m)%m.
